game.q: peter says yes, he loves him. what does jesus hand him?
opts: the biggest fish, as a peace offering

wrong.warn: no warning. no speech. he went straight to trust.
wrong.fish: the fish was already on the fire. he gave him more than that.

game.right: YES. not a lecture, a job. the man who ran away is put in charge of looking after the others.

end.line: he said “i am not” three times by one fire. by the next fire, he got three chances to say yes.
end.l2: three times, “you know i love you.”

cliff.s1: next, a man on a mission.
cliff.s2: he’s on his way to arrest jesus’s followers, and a light stops him on the road.

share: a denial by one fire, a breakfast by another. the story on infinite hill
